text:
sam: heads up — saw telemetry ingestion spike from thin clients after the mobile sdk reconnect loop. ~3x event rate and a lot of request bodies showing up in sampled inspect traces.
priya: ugh. did we get a repro? is it the reconnect or a retry storm from the CDN?
sam: pretty sure reconnect. devices retry quickly then flood until backoff kicks in. we currently sample requests uniformly, so PII-containing bodies get through during the peak.
alex: can we add a lightweight client header to request minimal telemetry during overload? e.g. `X-RW-TEL: minimal` — server routes to a low-PII logging tier and drops bodies for sampled events.
jess: +1 for a header. also need console UX to surface that the tenant is in "minimal telemetry" mode (heatmap + banner) so customers know why inspect shows fewer contextual fields.
priya: agree. two concerns: (1) header spoofing (clients faking it) and (2) quota accounting — we still charge tokens but reduce telemetry. Any auth checks?
amaria: header should be honored only when request authenticated and tenant config allows dynamic throttling. fallback: if header missing, server can decide based on per-tenant overload heuristics (qps > threshold) and set an outbound hint header to clients.
sam: sketch of backoff logic i've been prototyping:
```
# client-side simplified backoff hint handling
if resp.headers['X-RW-TEL-HINT'] == 'minimal':
  telemetry_rate = max(telemetry_rate * 0.5, min_rate)
else:
  telemetry_rate = min(telemetry_rate * 1.1, max_rate)
```
if we can surface `X-RW-TEL-HINT` in API responses, clients adopt immediately and reduce sampling.
alex: on the server side routing: add a low-PII route that strips request bodies and switches to pseudonymized user ids before persisting. This route should be cheap and not touch inspect payloads.
jess: console: new banner + route indicator on the request traces view. Also expose a temporary toggle to override minimal mode for a short window (ops breakglass) with audit log.
priya: ops breakglass needs RBAC + TTL + audit events. we can't allow indefinite overrides.
maria: rollout plan: canary 5% of tenants for 48h, observe reduction in inspect PII leakage and no spike in error rates. metrics: sampled-body-count, telemetry-ingest-rate, token-cost-per-minute.
sam: agreed. also add a metric for `minimal_mode_hits` so billing/observability folks can validate unit economics.
alex: a thought: for embeddings endpoints we should never send raw user text even in minimal mode — always hash + prefix. separate rule.
jess: UX note: show expected data fidelity loss when minimal mode active (small tooltip). customers will ask.
buildbot: deploy scheduled: rolling canary to 5% starting 2024-09-10 01:00 UTC.
maria: action items: (1) api: implement `X-RW-TEL-HINT` and honor header iff tenant allows (alex + sam) (2) runtime: low-PII route + pseudonymization (alex) (3) console: banner + heatmap + temp override (jess) (4) policy: RBAC + audit TTL (priya) (5) metrics & billing hooks (maria). I'll make a short RFC doc and link it.
sam: thanks — i'll open the RFC + canary checklist later today. :thumbsup:
